title: Review a Proposal's changes
description: Walk every change in a Proposal with Previous and Next, mark what you looked at, and undo a change together with the changes that depend on it.

steps.review-list: Every change is in one list. The count shows how many you have looked at.
steps.looked-at: Next marks the change you leave as looked at. Looking at a change does not approve it.
steps.undo-dependents: Undoing a change that others depend on names them first, so you can undo them together or cancel.

undo-dependents.motif-review-undo-prompt: Changes that depend on this one
